## Proposed change
Describe what changes, why, and which files are affected.

## Verification
- [ ] Changes are limited to the public repository.
- [ ] Tests were run or their absence is explained.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, internal KIA instructions, private endpoints or proprietary code are included.
- [ ] No production deployment, external operation, privilege change or paid call is included.
- [ ] Any AI-generated code was reviewed for correctness, licensing and security.

## Founder decision — maintained by the repository owner
**Default: PENDING.** The author may propose a change but cannot self-authorize it. A PR comment or checkbox alone is not approval.

- Decision: Pending founder review
- Authorized scope / PR number: _to be completed by founder_
- Production deployment approval (separate): Not granted

**Do not merge until the founder has explicitly approved this exact change and GitHub's enforced protection requirements pass.**
